{{Top|leg}}
'''''Wippet''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

'''Wippet''', escorted by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and its sister ship ''[[Redbill]]'' were to pick up [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] munitions stolen by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] with their own Cargo ferries ''[[Filcher]]'' and ''[[Riirdo]]'' to arrange a trade. However, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] followed by two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] arrived to reclaim the munitions. The Gunboats destroyed the pirate [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] [[Devil (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|''Devil'']] and disabled both ''Filcher'' and ''Riirdo'' and arrested the crews and destroyed both ''Redbill'' and ''Wippet'' before they could escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. The event was recorded to train future pilots such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
